entities.name: Timer T3402
entities.description: Timer T3402 is a network-controlled timer used in UE procedures. Its value can be configured by the network via specific messages and has a default value used under certain conditions.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to accept an attach request from the UE. It can carry the T3402 timer value.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to accept a tracking area update request from the UE. It can carry the T3402 timer value.

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to reject an attach request from the UE. It can carry the T3402 timer value, which must be integrity protected to be applied.

entities.name: T3402 deactivated condition
entities.description: Condition where the network indicates timer T3402 is deactivated, causing the UE to use the default timer value.

entities.name: New PLMN selected condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE selects a new PLMN not in the equivalent PLMN list, which may reset the T3402 timer to its default value under specific failure conditions.

entities.name: Default timer value used
entities.description: Property indicating the UE uses the default value of timer T3402 in cases such as no stored value, deactivation indication, or specific procedure failures.

relations.description: ATTACH ACCEPT message can contain the T3402 timer value for UE configuration.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message can contain the T3402 timer value for UE configuration.
ATTACH REJECT message can contain the T3402 timer value, which must be integrity protected to be applied.
If the network indicates T3402 is deactivated, the UE uses the default timer value.
When a new PLMN is selected and specific procedure failures occur, the UE uses the default T3402 timer value.
The T3402 timer value in ATTACH REJECT must be integrity protected for the UE to apply it.
